briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Michigan Tops $17B in Sales as Industry Rallies Behind Tax-Cut Candidate; Federal Psychedelics and Cannabis Policy Keep Advancing
briefs.top: Michigan operators have a real path forward this week: cumulative sales just crossed $17 billion and the state's top trade group is now backing a gubernatorial candidate who's pledged to gut the 24% wholesale tax. Nationally, momentum keeps building on multiple fronts — DEA rescheduling is grinding forward, Compass Pathways' psilocybin program hit another milestone, and Trump issued fresh marijuana clemency.
